bipartition_analysis.scientific_statement: All evaluated bipartitions have operating costs greater than or equal to those of the grand coalition. This establishes cost efficiency for complementary partitions of the complete nine-member community, without claiming universal superadditivity for arbitrary disjoint sub-coalitions.

limitations: Evaluated under annual perfect foresight (8,760 hours); short-horizon daily operations experience real-time forecast error penalties (~7.23% in 73-day rolling experiments).
Fixed canonical baseline DER endowments; does not model dynamic asset investment or grid expansion.
Descriptive coalition value scaling reflects physical asset complementarity within the Ausgrid network context, not generalizable causal law.
Community partition evaluations assume additive cost aggregation across independent sub-coalitions without inter-coalition wheeling charges.
Demographic incomes are fixed; consumer price elasticity of demand is not modeled.

data_provenance_notes.demographics_and_income: Canonical benchmark scenario profiles (socio-economic archetypes from ComErgy 2026 benchmark workbook columns P-T). They represent designed benchmark test cases for distributional justice analysis, not individual field-surveyed private data.

stability_findings.binding_definition: Coalitions whose excess e(S, u*) satisfies |e(S, u*) - epsilon*| <= 1e-5 AUD under the HiGHS simplex solver (feasibility tolerance 1e-8). These 8 coalitions form the active constraints at the least-core witness allocation.
